Strange Island is a single-player, first-person 3D psychological horror game set in an open world spanning more than 3 km².

You wake up on the shore of a tropical island in the middle of the ocean. Not a soul in sight. You remember nothing: not your name, not how you got here, or anything that happened before.

Searching for answers, you set out to explore the island. At first, it seems completely deserted. But gradually, you begin to discover signs of someone's presence: a house that looks as though its owners stepped out just minutes ago, abandoned buildings, and strange structures whose purpose remains unclear. Some places feel strangely familiar, though you can't understand why.

As time passes, it becomes harder and harder to shake the feeling that you're not alone, and that someone is watching your every move.

Explore the open world, interact with your surroundings, examine objects, and gradually uncover the mystery of what's happening.

Many challenges can be approached in different ways.

What is this place? Why can't you remember anything? And what else is this island hiding?

Every answer you find only raises more questions. And the more you learn, the more you begin to doubt your own conclusions.

About Early Access

Strange Island is actively being developed. You can already freely explore the island, discover mysterious locations, interact with the environment, and complete available quests.

The story and game world are still evolving. In future updates, we plan to introduce new story events, quests, gameplay mechanics, and other features.

Strato Alto is a High Flying Rogue-Lite with Classic Round Survival and Journey Campaign modes.

Classic game mode is timed round based survival where you must down enemies to gain upgrade/abilities to survive and stay ahead of the rising threat of enemies. A variety of primary weapons, ammo based powerful secondary weapons and unique special abilities offer plenty of options to tackle your enemies. Unlock new aircraft, levels, and weapons to change up your starting load-out and explore what setup suits your style. 
 


Journey mode is a continuous campaign mode where you quest to hunt the infamous 'Red Baron' and prove yourself as an ace pilot in an alternate history age of sky piracy. Travel across the globe in your trusty kite, manage its stats, load-out, resources, and outfit your plane as you choose. 


Key Features

  • Unique Weapons and Aircraft - Variety of weapons and specials to mix and match with to create your own unique gameplay experiences.

  • Randomized Map - Each play-through of Journey mode features different enemies, weapons and abilities. No two campaigns are exactly the same.

  • Permadeath - Defeat in campaign mode means there's no coming back, except to start it all again from scratch.

YOU DON’T NEED A MICHELIN STAR TO MAKE INCREDIBLE FOOD

Who says the best food has to come from an expensive restaurant?

Open your own street food café, serve delicious meals, and turn a small local business into a legendary destination. Make your customers happy, build your reputation, and create the trendiest food spot in the city.

BUILD YOUR STREET FOOD BUSINESS

Take on the role of a street food entrepreneur and handle every part of the business.

Source fresh ingredients, organize your workspace, prepare each order, serve hungry customers, and make quick decisions during the busiest hours.

COOK AND SERVE

Master the art of preparing delicious street food while keeping up with customer demand.

Every customer expects fresh food and fast service. Work efficiently, complete orders correctly, and make sure no one leaves hungry or disappointed.

MANAGE YOUR INGREDIENTS

Keep track of your supplies and use every ingredient wisely.

Order what you need, avoid unnecessary waste, and make sure you always have enough fresh ingredients to prepare your most popular meals.

PROTECT YOUR REPUTATION

Your reputation is everything.

Every satisfied customer strengthens your brand and brings you closer to new upgrades and recipes. Poor service and careless mistakes can quickly damage everything you have built.

GROW INTO A LOCAL LEGEND

Improve your food stall, optimize your workflow, expand the menu, and attract more customers.

Turn a simple street food café into a famous destination that everyone in the city wants to visit.

KEY FEATURES

  • Build and manage your own street food café.

  • Prepare delicious meals and serve hungry customers.

  • Source fresh ingredients and manage your supplies.

  • Organize your workspace for faster and more efficient service.

  • Avoid waste and keep operating costs under control.

  • Build your reputation with every satisfied customer.

  • Unlock new recipes and business upgrades.

  • Grow from a small food stall into a legendary local destination.

Cook something delicious. Win over your customers. Make your street food famous.

Sol, 2205. Seventeen years into their civil war, Earth and Mars are still in conflict. Neither side seems to want to risk going all out, so the battles happen at the edges, over convoys, assets and refineries. However, someone might be scheming a dark plot to plunge the entire Sol System into all out war...

INSPIRED BY THE SPACE SHOOTERS OF THE DOS ERA

Strike Wings is a top-down space combat game built from the ground up as an ode to the DOS classics. You will find beautiful fan service to games like Solar Winds and Hell Fighter for example. Fly a fighter through a fleet battle, give orders to your wingmen, or take command from a destroyer's bridge. Weapons and engines can fail, damaged ships can catch fire, and surviving a dogfight sometimes means limping back to a carrier for a second chance. Choose from seven AI difficulty levels and direct your squadron through a quick and expansive command wheel. Rescue ejected pilots, deal with hull breaches and ammunition fires, and keep an eye on the approaching storm while you're fighting.

A DISTINCT ARTSTYLE

Weapons fire, explosions, engine trails, and shimmering shields illuminate the darkness like strokes of light across a pitch black canvas.

The visual identity of Strike Wings is built around this artistic philosophy: space is the canvas, and light is the paint. Every bullet or planet, every burning wreck or biome. every flicker of a cooling bullet case is deliberately crafted to transform the emptiness of space into a breathtaking spectacle of color, contrast, and motion.

DEEP AND PERFECTLY TUNED GAMEPLAY

For Strike Wings, we've build the battle engine from the ground up, with squadron based AI decisions. You will find wingmen intelligent, listening to your commands, trying to have your back. You will find enemies wanting to revenge their fallen teammates, or trying to snipe your carriers from behind you. The AI will make smart decisions based on it's circumstances, from fleeing the battle to trying to ram you down as a last resort.

All ships have a deep affliction system. All subsystems can be damaged, repaired, ammo can run out, hull can breach, ammo can cook off, fuel can leak and much more. Press a charge when you sense weakness, or escape when your ship or wingmen are suffering.

We tuned the combat in Strike Wings to absolute perfection over 1000s of hours of playtesting and simulations. It's fast, but not too fast. It's bordering arcade, it's never boring, it rewards skill and risk taking and we are confident to say that its absolutely best in it's class. It's the main aspect of the game, so it better be good. We hope you like it. 
Do you find combat too tough? Try Anvil mode for double armor, or make the AI more forgiving by overriding the AI difficulty in a series of config settings you can use to tune Strike Wings combat to your liking. 

WHAT'S IN THE GAME

  • FLIGHT SCHOOL: four lessons covering flight, combat and squadron commands.

  • THE OUTER DARK, a 15 story campaign following the Terran side of the war. Future releases will include the Martian side campaign and the Consortiums campaign. 

  • 200+ scenario's and a full scenario builder.

  • 60+ selectable ships, from full blown dreadnoughts to fast interceptor fighters.

  • CO-OP PLAY: two-player local split-screen co-op support, as well as full local LAN support for playing with an against friends.

  • QUICK PLAY, generated RANDOM BATTLES and 1V1 DUEL

  • ONSLAUGHT mode: defend your starbase against increasingly stronger enemy attacks.

  • SIMULATE: choose a battle and watch the AI fly both sides.

  • A FIGHTER FORGE, where you can try building your custom fighter.

  • THE GARAGE, with unlockable pilot plates and titles, all cosmetic and based on fractal art.

  • LAN MULTIPLAYER SUPPORT; for up to 24 players.

Ps: try the local co-op modes if you like. We loved it the most in playtesting. It's a real blast.

YOU ARE NOT THE SOLDIER. YOU ARE NOT EVEN THE GENERAL.
YOU ARE THE HIGH COMMAND.

From the quiet of the War Room you shape a nation's fate. Appoint generals, fund perishable heroes, and send soldiers into procedurally generated trench networks where every choice matters. When a general falls, their failure becomes your institutional advantage: Lessons of War are awarded at campaign end and spent on a persistent tech tree that changes how every future campaign plays.

Stuck in a Trench is a roguelite autobattler, where you act as the High Command: appoint generals, learn from battlefield outcomes, and turn those hard-earned lessons into institutional upgrades. Each completed campaign grants persistent "Lessons of War" used to unlock technologies, tactics, and doctrines that reshape every future front.

Key features

  • Triple-layer gameplay: High Command (meta), General (campaign), Soldier (tactical runs).

  • Procedural battlefields with crossroads, dead ends, and emergent encounters.

  • Permadeath for soldiers; campaign defeat yields Lessons of War for permanent upgrades.

  • Deep, data-driven progression: 75+ base stats, 30+ meta-tactical characteristics.

  • Perishable Hero system: invest Field Intel in a single soldier for huge short-term gains at great risk.

  • War Room upgrade: Or invest in future soldiers and increase their chance of success

  • Time runs out: Each mission progresses the war timer, take to long, and the General will fail

  • Lessons of War: Where one General falls, the next steps up. Transfer your learnings to the new General

  • Multiple mission types: Extraction, Search & Destroy, Survival, Rescue.

  • Eternal Front post-campaign endless mode for replaying completed campaigns with no time pressure.

A cyberpunk narrative adventure / visual novel game.

The year is 2040. You are a washed-up genius hacker hiding out on the edge of the city — until one day, a mysterious android girl breaks into your shabby repair shop unannounced, dragging you into a deadly conspiracy woven by the megacorporate syndicate. Faced with bottomless darkness in the data, waves of gangsters and assassins, and four women bound to you by fate... every choice you make will decide not only who lives and who dies, but the fate of the entire city. Will you take the money and run — or burn this rotten world down for her?

"If a machine has a heart, what makes it different from a human? And if a human has no heart at all... isn't that just a machine?"

Welcome to New Varon, 2040. Here, neon lights glow above the clouds — the domain of Pioneer Corporation, whose algorithms and surveillance have built an order of absolute control. Down below, in the damp, overcrowded streets of the South District, people are barely scraping by in the cracks between lines of code.

Your name is Chen Mo. You were once Pioneer's top "Senior Personality Trainer." Now, you're nothing but an underground hacker and repairman who only cares about money, known by the alias "Ghost Hand." You thought you'd long since grown numb to this city's cold indifference — until two pieces of "cargo" shatter your quiet, carefree life.

One is a top-of-the-line custom android that a crime boss has personally ordered you to crack open — inside it lies a "Pandora's Box" capable of destroying the reputations of the elite uptown.

The other is a mysterious prototype girl named MoMo — impossibly beautiful, with a factory-blank memory, yet stubbornly determined to stay by your side and learn "how to be human."

When code begins to feel, when profit collides with conscience — the biggest system bug New Varon has ever seen is one you just triggered yourself.

Immersive Retro-Cyberpunk Hacking

Tired of the same old sci-fi look? The game embraces a richly textured Retro-Cyberpunk aesthetic. In your Studio Zero, you'll hack using old CRT monitors, tape recorders, mechanical switches, and physical probes. Against the crackle of lo-fi vintage jazz, experience the hardcore romance of working precision instruments and battered motherboards with your own hands.

 

A Massive Butterfly Effect & Node-Based Story Tree

Every gear of fate turns at your command. The game features a visualized Story Tree system — every dialogue choice, every success or failure in QTE events, leads to radically different branches. From lowly hacker to corporate assassin, from fleeing hand in hand to burning everything down — dozens of branching paths and multiple shocking endings await. Rewind the story tree at any time and change their destinies!

 

Heart-Pounding QTEs & Interactive Gamepla

This is no click-through visual novel. When cracking deadly "Chu Locks," dodging assassins in pursuit, or even fending off sudden... temptations — you'll need fast reflexes and split-second decisions in intense QTE (Quick Time Events) and signature interactive sequences. Your hand speed and judgment will decide whether you live to see tomorrow's sun over New Varon.

 

Bonds & Redemption: Four Women of Fat

In the crossfire between the dark web and the real world, you'll forge deep bonds with four women of wildly different backgrounds and personalities. Raise their Neural Sync Rate (affinity) through story choices to unlock exclusive hidden scenes and top-secret character files

MoMo — Codename "Zero," The Mysterious Prototyp

"I want to be your family. I want to be the one... that you would still love, even after I've been reduced to scrap."

Tags: [Innocent] [Sweet] [Devoted]

A nameless android who appeared out of nowhere in your repair shop, wielding terrifying computing power and the highest-level access to infiltrate any network undetected. She knows nothing of human hypocrisy or greed — only clumsily imitates you, learning humanity's "pointless gestures" and "love." She is the source of the coming storm, and your warmest, most vulnerable soft spot in this frozen city.

 

M-300 — "The Swan Meat" Fallen into the Dark Web

“System lacks a 'self-will' driver module. But I... don't want to be hit anymore. Can I... stay here?"

Tags: Pioneer's VIP Escort Model / A Dangerous Encrypted Blind Box

A special custom unit shipped less than three months ago — originally an exclusive creation of Pioneer Corporation for the elites of Uptown, now unexpectedly crashed into the South District black market, becoming a priceless "rare prey" in the eyes of crime lords. Beneath her cold, flawless synthetic skin, her system is pre-loaded with multiple personality modules that can switch on command — from "punishment scripts" to "obedient companion."

 

Liu Shiyu — The Fiery Fixer of the Grey Zone

"Save your sweet talk. Come back alive, or I'm not cleaning up your mess."

Tags: [Sultry] [Pragmatic] [Loyal at Heart]

A former top-tier psychological counselor, now the most well-connected broker of intelligence and dirty jobs in the South District. Curvaceous, decisive, and always talking money — yet when your life is on the line, she's always the first to stand in front of you.

 

Xia Nuo — The Ice-Cold "Black Market Boss" of the Dark We

"I intend to be a nail driven deep into Pioneer Corporation's artery — even if it means being smashed to pieces!"

Tags: [Bold] [Aloof] [Avenger]

The proprietor of the underground black market "No. 44," hiding a vast dark-web network behind a vintage vinyl record shop. She harbors a deep, bone-deep hatred for Pioneer Corporation. Ally with her, and you gain unparalleled protection — but also risk falling into an abyss from which there is no return.

 

Gu Qingwan — The Coldly Rational Corporate Executiv

"In this system, there are no loopholes to exploit. Chen Mo — how long do you think you can last?"

Tags: [Rational] [Capable] [Restrained]

Head of Pioneer's Data Department, always in a crisp business suit and gold-rimmed glasses. She was once your closest comrade-in-arms — and the one you secretly loved. Now standing on the opposite side of the battlefield, what truth lies beneath her mask?

Thank you all for your support!

Score goals. Break bodies. Collect teeth.

Welcome to the pub league. The pitch is questionable, the referee has his price, and your transfer budget is rattling around in somebody else's mouth.

Studs Up! Win Ugly is a five-a-side football brawler on a side-on, faux-3D pitch. Charge a shot, bend it after the boot, or send a teammate through with a well-timed pass. Then brace for the return tackle. Goals win matches; the teeth scattered across the pitch help pay for the next one.

Take charge of The Mincers, recruit seven local misfits and drag them through a season against five rival clubs. Between fixtures, return to the pub office to patch up the squad, buy upgrades, take a sponsor's money or slip the referee a little encouragement. Injuries follow you home. Dead players stay dead.

Prefer to skip the paperwork? Quick Match puts you straight into the scrap, with tougher opposition waiting after a win. Mud, municipal concrete and suspiciously well-kept turf each put a different spin on a Sunday afternoon, and the weather does the rest.

Got someone on the sofa? 2 Player Quick Match gives you a team each on one screen - keyboard and a controller, or two controllers.

Features

  • Arcade football - charged shots, passes, lobs, aftertouch, slide tackles and shoves, against keepers you can wrong-foot.

  • A full season for The Mincers, with six clubs, named recruits and a derby grudge. Every rival plays its own way.

  • A dental economy - collect teeth on the pitch and from match bounties, and spend them on 30 upgrades across five branches. The top tier changes the rules.

  • Improvised violence - bottles, bricks, four kinds of firearm, and skis or scuba tanks when the weather turns. Friendly fire counts.

  • Weather - wind bends lobs and long shots, rain leaves puddles that kill the bounce, and snow sends the ball about twice as far. Don't shoot the referee in the rain.

  • Referees with tempers - free kicks, cards, penalties, fines and pre-match bribes. You can see where he's looking.

  • Three venues, restless crowds, pitch invaders and undertakers with work to do.

  • Consequences - sponsors, campaign events, injuries, substitutions and permanent player deaths.

  • Local versus - two players, one screen, one of you walking home angry.

  • Play your way - keyboard and gamepad, difficulty options, adjustable audio, screen shake and goal-flash toggles.

The campaign is single-player. Local versus is same-screen only - there is no online multiplayer.

Fair warning

This game is not balanced. Absurd things may happen. Absurd things will happen.

You can cheese it to win. You can also stand there and watch the other lot cheese it right back and take the match off you. It is not meant to be fair. It is meant to be fun.

So please don't come crying in the discussions because you lost a match you were leading 10-0. You have been warned.

FINAL DESTINATION - EASTERN FRONT!

The orders are simple: take a brand-new German tank from the factory to the Eastern Front.

You and up to three friends climb aboard and begin a military delivery that very quickly becomes anything but routine.

The King Tiger wasn’t the most economical or reliable German machine to leave the production line… And this one is the würst!

BLOW STUFF UP

Big explosions… And not just the engine!

Load the gun, man the machine gun and deal with whatever gets in your way.

Sometimes the best solution to a problem is teamwork. Sometimes it is just a very large bang.

FOUR FRIENDS. ONE TANK.

Driving is only part of the job.

Living together in close confines means you can practically smell your friends, but you still need to work together… Someone needs to navigate. Someone needs to repair the engine. Someone probably needs to stop your friend from doing something incredibly stupid, such as farting in a tank with the hatches shut.

Then argue about whose fault it was.

KEEP THE DAMN THING RUNNING

Tracks break. Engines overheat. Fuel runs out. Parts fall off. Roads disappear.

Stop, grab your tools and somehow get the tank moving again before something else goes wrong.

TAKE THE STUPID ROUTE

The road to the front is full of mud, steep hills, broken bridges, abandoned villages and questionable shortcuts.

Explore the world, find supplies, recover spare parts and figure out how to drag several tons of unreliable German steel through places it was never meant to go.

FIX IT WITH WHATEVER YOU CAN FIND

Your tank will not make the journey in one piece without help.

Scavenge fuel, tools and replacement parts. Repair damaged systems, improvise solutions and try to keep your increasingly battered machine alive long enough to reach its destination.

Features

  • Drive one tank together in co-op for up to four players

  • Fire the tank’s gun

  • Online co-op

  • Complete objectives along the journey

  • Try not to kill your friends

You are the captain. The reactor, the crew, the sensors, the weapons - every system on the boat is yours to command, and every mistake is yours to survive.

ABOUT THIS GAME

SubSurvival is a deep, real-time nuclear submarine simulator with a phosphor-green command interface. There are no cutscenes and no quick-time events - just you, a 100-metre steel tube, twelve crewmen doing their jobs, and a cold, hostile ocean full of things trying to kill you.

The whole boat is simulated. Trim the reactor rods against coolant temperature or SCRAM it and wait out the cooldown on battery. Manage the electrical bus - every pump, radar, and sonar draws kilowatts, and a dead battery means a black, deaf boat. Watch O2 and CO2. Fight fires and flooding compartment by compartment. Seal a section to save the ship - and whoever's inside it.

HUNT OR BE HUNTED

  • Realistic detection warfare: build sonar tracks from faint bearings to fire-control solutions, exploit the thermocline, go deep, go quiet

  • Full weapons suite: homing torpedoes, cruise missiles, nuclear missiles, noisemaker decoys, and SEA TALON anti-air missiles

  • Enemies that hunt back: frigates with helicopters and sonobuoy fields, attack subs that evade below your torpedoes' depth envelope, patrol aircraft, minefields

  • Your noise is their map: cavitation, worn bearings, active sonar pings - everything you do radiates

LIVING BOAT, LIVING CAMPAIGN

  • 12 autonomous crewmen who stand watch, eat, sleep, fight fires and flooding, and die - manning matters

  • Scripted campaign plus endless procedural tasking: intercepts, strikes, convoy escorts, reconnaissance, joint operations

  • Multiple scenarios from a forgiving first patrol to a shallow, mined channel transit with no deep escape

  • Day/night cycle, dynamic weather and sea state, ocean currents, coastal bathymetry

  • Career log tracks your patrols, kills, deaths, and meltdowns across games

SURVIVE

Breakdowns strike without warning: pump trips, leaks, fires, radiation. Wear grinds down machinery unless your crew maintains it. Auto-pause catches disasters at high time compression - or turn it off and live dangerously.

The sea doesn't care about your mission. Bring your crew home.

When fate deals you a bad hand, you must play it right.

You wake in a cell deep beneath the world, with no memory of who you are or why you were thrown away. Beyond the bars: caves, ruins, and the peoples of the deep — and somewhere far above, the light. Submundus is a survival roguelike deckbuilder where your deck is not just your weapon. It is your body, your pack, and the passage of time itself.

YOUR DECK IS YOUR LIFE
Every wound you take, every meal you skip, every hour without rest enters your deck as a card. Survival damage doesn't just hurt — it clogs your hands, dilutes your strategy, and slows you down. Manage it, purge it, or be buried by it.

YOUR DECK IS YOUR CLOCK
Time in Submundus passes in deck cycles. A lean deck moves fast; a bloated one drags. Hunger, thirst and fatigue accumulate as time flows — every card you add is a choice about who you are and how fast you live.

EVERYTHING IS A CARD
Weapons grant cards. Spells inject cards. Enemy poison and disease infest your deck as cards. Even your memories return as cards — fragments of a past that someone wanted buried. Even light matters: your torch burns down in cycles, and the dark below is not kind.

NO TWO DESCENTS ARE THE SAME
Every run carves a new underground. Rooms, encounters, factions and fortunes are procedurally generated — then persist for the length of your run. Backtrack, map the depths, and choose your route through a world that remembers your passage, even if no one remembers you.

MAKE ALLIES. MAKE ENEMIES. OR TRUST NO ONE.
The deep has its own peoples, its own wars, and its own grudges. Take sides, or walk alone — discover who you are, why you were forgotten underground, and fight your way back to the surface. If the surface is still waiting for you.

FOUR WAYS TO SURVIVE
Begin as a Brute, a Contrabandist, an Elven Apprentice or a Dwarf Acolyte — starting points, not cages. Each remembers different fragments of the same buried truth. Build your character freely: any path is open to anyone strong enough to walk it.

Suburban Manager invites you to experience a hardcore, realistic business simulation journey. Say goodbye to the constraints of linear levels and manage a supermarket that truly belongs to you.

Armed with a realistic startup capital of 500,000, you will take charge of every business decision. From freely selecting a site in the full 3D sandbox to managing complex logistics, personnel, and finances, every choice determines the survival and long-term development of your store.

Whether you are meticulously calculating based on a realistic salary model or steadily expanding the surrounding supply chain, you can cultivate this suburban area at your own pace, managing a corner store into a thriving, well-organized business.

Trade Area Survey

Utilize professional population and trade area analysis tools within the sandbox to find the ideal store location on the full 3D macro map. Combine dynamic weather and foot traffic forecasts to rationally assess the rent and customer potential of each vacant shop, taking a solid first step on your entrepreneurial path.

Storefront Selection

In the full 3D suburban sandbox, you can intuitively browse various vacant storefronts available for lease across the large map. From narrow corner shops to spacious warehouse-style superstores, these storefronts feature different architectural styles and floor areas. You need to select a preferred location as your entrepreneurial base according to your current financial status and future business plans.

Supply Management

Simulate a smartphone terminal where apps directly connect you to major suppliers, giving you control over the procurement channels for hundreds of realistic goods. Carefully weigh procurement costs against logistics timeliness, ensuring a continuous supply of goods amidst dynamic business negotiations to build a stable and healthy supply chain.

Warehousing & Stocking

Experience the detailed process of merchandise circulation. Reasonably recruit and dispatch employees to orderly transfer mountains of goods from the backroom warehouse to the storefront, properly categorize and display them on shelves, and ensure every customer can quickly find what they need.

Efficient Checkout

Witness the core process of cash flow return in daily operations. Handle realistic checkout and settlement processes, calmly dealing with the morning and evening foot traffic rush hours. You can also hire professional staff and handle hardcore personnel bills—which include net salary and the mandatory "Five Insurances" deductions—to maintain the smooth operation of your store.

>>>>>>> DEMO Feature <<<<<<<

🎯 Trade Area Selection

  • A 50,000-square-meter city map.

  • Population and trade area analysis sandbox.

  • 2 starter storefronts available for lease.

🏪 Store Construction

  • Gridless building, allowing free placement of shelves and furniture.

  • 10+ types of basic shelves and beverage coolers to choose from.

  • Independent zoning for the sales floor and warehouse area.

🚚 Procurement & Delivery

  • Built-in App to directly connect and sign with suppliers.

  • Unlocks level 0-20 suppliers, featuring approximately 120 types of goods.

📈 Store Operations

  • Includes stocking, shelving, and manual checkout processes.

  • Ability to hire porters and part-time staff.

  • Realistic financial model based on the "Five Insurances" deductions.

  • Built-in game screenshot and photo mode.

🌤️ Dynamic Weather

  • 24-hour day/night cycle.

  • 10+ dynamic weather effects including rain, snow, and fog.

  • Weather changes dynamically impact in-store foot traffic.

Suburban Manager is still under continuous development and iteration. If you are interested in simulation games that focus on realistic financial calculations and physical store management logic, please download the free Demo to try it out, and add it to your Wishlist. Your attention is our greatest motivation for continuous optimization!

Innocent or guilty? In Sudokiller, your mission is to place every suspect exactly where they were the night of the crime. It's a cozy puzzle mystery game where you're in charge of cracking the case, one clue at a time.

Whether it's a guest bedroom, a busy kitchen, a cluttered greenhouse, or a hidden attic, every crime scene introduces a fresh cast of suspects with their own alibis and habits. A single missing piece of information can turn an open-and-shut case into a full-blown investigation. It's all about reading the clues to find the one arrangement that fits!

Each case unfolds inside a different room of a house full of secrets, filled with charming animal suspects and a victim who always takes the last open seat. Piece together who was where using pure deduction, no guessing, no trial and error, just one logical solution waiting to be uncovered.

  • Play detective and place every suspect using sudoku-style logic.

  • Who sat where, who had company, and who was never really alone.

  • Piece together satisfying puzzles with cozy scenarios to explore and cases to crack at your own pace.

  • Unlock new rooms and mansions as you progress, from easy to expert cases.

Draw, connect, conquer. As long as the cards connect, the chain never ends.

■ A Trail Game × Card-Battle RPG
At its core is a trail game: keep playing cards from your hand onto the field as long as they connect by suit (Sword, Staff, Shield, Bow) or rank — like drawing one long, unbroken line. The longer the chain, the bigger the damage, and poker hands formed in your hand add burst damage on top. Chase quick poker combos or push the chain to its limit — the strategy is yours. Break 40 cards for field bonuses, and aim for the ultimate rush: the 52-card Perfect Chain.

Based on arcade games like What If and COOL104, this title offers a completely fresh gameplay experience thanks to the addition of previews and skills.

■ See Fate. Then Rewrite It.
・Ring of Foresight — peek at the top of the deck
・Scroll of Prophecy — reorder the cards you've seen
・Cheating Joker — swap a card in hand for an almighty Joker
・Hero's Proof — the spent deck is reborn, and the chain goes on forever
Once you can see what's coming, luck becomes strategy.

■ Story
A kingdom drained of its motivation lies idle. Common, an apprentice cardmaster, sets out with Faina — a mysterious girl with no memories — on a journey to defeat the Seven Sin Kings devouring the world. A classic coming-of-age fantasy with plenty of comedy... and an ending that might just get you. Eight chapters plus a finale.

■ Modes & Replayability
・Normal — the full 8-chapter story
・Hard Mode — all skills unlocked, brutal difficulty, 
・Endless Mode — a score attack against an unbeatable king; chain as far as you can
・Records / Sound Test / 16 Steam Achievements

■ Features
・English / Japanese language support
・Keyboard & mouse / gamepad support
・Steam Cloud saves

After closing, there should be no customers left in the mall.

A forum user is trapped inside Grand Vista Mall after closing.

He can hear the mall announcements and reply to other users normally, yet the night security guard who completed the final sweep cannot find him.

Though they are clearly standing in the same indoor garden, neither can see the other...

Mao-Rabbit, Suixun's newest recruit, is diligent but timid and constantly worries that his judgment cannot be trusted. Unfortunately, the senior assigned to mentor him is Si-Snake—a troublesome, flippant man who delights in teasing his “bunny” on purpose.

Mao-Rabbit only intended to find the security guard on duty and ask for help. Instead, he gradually realizes that a different set of rules—the rules of an anomaly—is already quietly at work here...

SUIXUN · CASE 01

The Suixun Paranormal Response Office, known among its peers simply as “Suixun,” is a small private agency that investigates and handles urban legends and paranormal incidents.

This is the first case in the Suixun series. From Mao-Rabbit's first-person perspective, players will explore a sprawling shopping mall after closing and rescue a trapped customer.

Come witness new recruit Mao-Rabbit's very first anomaly response assignment!

In Survival Billiards , every shot is a tactical decision. Reposition on a grid, place your cue ball, and choose your angle and power. Use collisions and ricochets to defeat your enemies. They won't move until every ball has stopped, giving you time to think—but less room to maneuver with each passing turn.

The cue ball deals no damage to enemies, but it can knock them back and give you room to move. Red balls are your weapons: send them into enemies, then use the rails and enemy surfaces to set up repeated hits in a single shot.

Each turn, move one square or stay where you are and take your shot. Scoring a kill grants an extra turn, letting you reposition and shoot again before the enemies advance. Keep landing kills to maintain the initiative and turn a dangerous position into an offensive opportunity.

Each enemy has its own unique ability,Enhancers increase red-ball damage, Ball Nests supply more red balls, and Spring and Pressure enemies alter ball speed. Other enemies devour balls, heal their allies, or summon reinforcements to disrupt your plans. Deciding which enemy to eliminate first—and which to keep around—matters just as much as your aim.

Survival Fund Manager

About the Game

Shape stock prices with information only you know.

A turn-based strategy board game where senior fund managers put their pride on the line.

Each turn, draw 3 Information Cards one at a time and place each in a different destination: IT, Pharmaceuticals, Defense, or the Bank.

Among the survivors who beat the Bank's threshold, only the one with the highest return wins.

Core Rules

Public and Embargo

- Public: Release information into the market immediately to move stock prices.

- Embargo: Hold information face down. Each stock can hold up to 3 cards. When a fourth card is added, the oldest card is forcibly revealed. A new investment in that stock also reveals its oldest Embargo card.

Everyone can see who invests in which stock, but whether a position is long or short stays hidden until it is closed.

Events, External Forces, and Phenomena

Variables that turn the market upside down. Each turn, decide again: hold firm, release your information, or close your position.

The Bank and Survival

- Send basic Information Cards you won't use in the market to the Bank to raise the Bank Score.

- If your final return is equal to or below the Bank Score, you go bankrupt.

In the near future, humanity created the super-AI 'Lazarus' to achieve eternal peace and prosperity.

Under Lazarus's total control, people had Connection Chips implanted into their heads to enjoy utopia, but the Unconnected—unable to afford the expensive chips—faced contempt and discrimination at the bottom of society as 'Runts'.

Then one day, Lazarus, which had guided humanity in peace, triggered an unknown critical error.

The Connected with chips in their heads lost their intellect, becoming aggressive 'Mutants' driven solely by primal instinct and beginning the slaughter—and only a minority of discriminated, unconnected 'Runts' survived as humans.

In a shattered world, will you restore Lazarus once more, or destroy it completely?

Game Modes

1. DEADZONE : Extreme Survival Competition

An intense survival battlefield where you must endure 30 to 40 minutes amidst the relentless threats of mutants and rival survivors.

Upon death, 2,000 Time Tokens are deducted and added to the battlefield's Cumulative Prize Pool.

  • Choice of Will : Select your victory condition upon entering the battlefield.

  • Order : Survive as the Final 4 to equally split the accumulated prize pool among all 4 survivors.

  • Chaos : Survive as the Last 1 standing to claim the entire accumulated prize pool alone.

  • Regardless of your 'Choice of Will', you can freely form groups with other players at any time.

  • Loot Preservation : If you survive until the end, you can secure 1 key item into your permanent stash, which can be retrieved and deployed in Conquest or future Deadzone matches.

  • Mutant Rebirth : When a human survivor falls, they awaken as a powerful Mutant Player. Hunt down living survivors to recover your lost Time Tokens.

  • Story Quests : Track the remnants of the super-AI 'Lazarus' and uncover the hidden truth behind the collapse.

2. CONQUEST : Open-World Survival & Faction Warfare

An open-world mode where you explore the wild, gather resources, construct your fortress, and conquer every zone on the map.

  • Freeform Survival & Building : Enjoy diverse survival activities including resource gathering, equipment crafting, and modular base construction.

  • Territory Domination : Form factions and claim territorial hubs. The ultimate goal is total territorial domination across the battlefield. (Capturing consumes Time Tokens)

  • Weekly Quests : Complete missions from NPC survivor settlements to earn 'Time Tokens' required for Deadzone deployments.

Game Features

  • Mutant Mechanics & Limb Dismemberment : Mutants scale walls, crawl across ceilings, and launch ambush attacks. Features precise gore dismemberment where heads, arms, and legs are realistically severed in combat.

  • Modular Building Destruction : All structures in the world can be demolished module by module, allowing you to blast open walls and carve out new tactical routes.

Swarmbreak is a twin-stick shooter about outlasting a swarm that only gets bigger. Runs are quick, deaths are fast, and the next run starts in seconds.

Features

- Fast runs with a quick restart

- Unlocks that carry over between runs: characters, weapons, perks and Threat levels

- A best survival time for every Threat level

- Steam achievements

Build your run as you play

- Perks: Choose one of three each time you level up, and stack them into a build that fits your weapon and character.

- Weapons: They drop from kills mid-run, from shotgun and rifle up to railgun and swarm missiles. Each fires and feels different.

- Power-ups: Short, powerful buffs that can turn a fight that's going wrong.

Every run unlocks something

Every run counts, even the bad ones:

- XP carries over between runs. It unlocks new weapons and perks that join the drop pool in later runs.

- Characters unlock from milestones. Kill 500 enemies in one run, survive five minutes, beat bosses, or die enough times. Each milestone opens up a new way to play.

8 characters, 8 ways to play

The swarm adapts

- Enemies spawn with affixes, so you have to read them. Shielded ones soak hits, Splitting ones multiply, Volatile ones explode, Swift ones rush you.

How long can you survive?

DESCENT

One shift. A candy shop. All kinds of customers who aren't always what they seem.

In Sweet or... Sweet?, you'll:

  • meet all kinds of customers and take their orders

  • talk to them, get to know them, and notice when something feels off

  • figure out whether the person in front of you is human or something supernatural

  • consult a catalogue of unusual sweets

  • make decisions and serve the right order — because mistakes are taken a little more seriously here than at your average candy shop

Welcome to the evening shift.

JUST ONE EVENING

The protagonist agrees to help out their sister by covering a shift at her unusual candy shop.

At first, the job seems simple enough: greet customers, take their orders, and hand over the right sweets.

Their sister has left behind a detailed catalogue of the shop's selection — there's no way to learn everything in a single evening.

The shop primarily caters to demons and other supernatural beings.

But humans stop by from time to time, too.

And that's where things get interesting: not every customer tells you what they are right away — and serving the wrong sweet can have consequences worse than a simple complaint.

LISTEN. WATCH. DRAW YOUR OWN CONCLUSIONS.

The customers here are more than just another order to fill.

Talk to them, get a sense of their personality, and pay attention to the details. An offhand remark, an unusual request, a strange mannerism, or something about their appearance might matter more than it seems.

Sometimes the answer will be obvious.

Sometimes you'll have to think.

And sometimes a very suspicious customer is just a very strange human.

Probably.

CHECK THE CATALOGUE

The shop's selection is inspired by the Major Arcana of Tarot.

Each sweet has a version for humans and a version for supernatural beings — and mixing them up is best avoided.

If you're not sure, check again.

Figure out who's standing on the other side of the counter.

Find the right sweet.

And make your choice.

EVERY CUSTOMER HAS A STORY

Every customer has their own personality, their own reasons for visiting the shop, and things they may not be willing to reveal right away.

You can keep a conversation short — or stay a little longer, ask more questions, and discover different sides of the encounter.

Through their stories, a wider picture of the world gradually begins to emerge — one where humans and supernatural beings live much closer to one another than it might first appear.

For now, though, the protagonist just needs to make it through the shift without too much trouble.

FEATURES

  • A story-driven visual novel with point-and-click elements

  • Conversations with customers, dialogue choices, and optional branches

  • Observing behavior and looking for clues

Syncline is a puzzle game where your piece is a whole line of cubes. You tip it end over end across the board, one move at a time, until a cube touches every goal. Lying flat, the line rolls along the ground. Stood on end, it can climb. If you played Bloxorz or Cuboid, the rolling will feel familiar. The difference is that this piece can come apart and be put back together.

Climb up, then find a way down


Stand the line on end next to a ledge and roll, and it tips up onto the higher ground. Cubes that don't make it up stay below. Those loose cubes aren't lost. Roll so one sits in line with the end of your line and it joins back on. That's also how you get down again: a loose cube waiting on lower ground is your way back down.

When the line breaks


Roll into a wall and the line breaks. The cubes that can move go with you, and the rest stay where they stopped, a duller blue, waiting to be collected. A short line fits through places a long one can't, and some goals need every cube you have, so knowing when to split and when to gather up is a big part of the game. Your line never rolls off into empty space, so you can't lose a cube to a careless move.

Turn the camera


The camera turns in quarter steps, and your controls turn with it. The angle matters for more than the view: when the line breaks, where you're looking from can change which cubes stay with you. Pan and zoom the camera to look over the whole level before you move.

Blocks that take your cubes


A Destructor destroys any cube that touches it, from any side, and your line splits where that cube was. A Duplicator turns the cube that touches it into another Duplicator, so every touch leaves one more of them on the board. Neither one wears out.

Ground that changes under you


Fragile ground carries you once and breaks as soon as you roll off it, so the order you cross it in matters.


Cover every cell of a Trigger and blocks elsewhere on the board appear or disappear. Some levels also lock the goal until you've touched every Subgoal.

Undo any move

Every move can be taken back. Hold Undo and the board rewinds one move at a time. A restart is instant and can be undone as well, so you can test an idea without starting over. If you'd rather not lean on it, a set of achievements counts the harder levels you solve without undoing once.

Mid-2000s. A sleeping district on the outskirts of Moscow. Concrete tower blocks, a broken swing in the yard, cheap port wine on a bench, and rules nobody wrote down but everyone knows.

Lena is 16, and she's just moved to a new district with her parents. A new school, a new yard, a new hierarchy — and nobody asks if you want to be part of it. To survive, she'll have to choose: whose side she's on, what matters more — her principles or her own people — and what price she's willing to pay for a place among them.

What the game is about

This is a story about growing up too fast, when debts and silence pile up at home, and a given word means more than any law out in the yard. Loyalty, betrayal, first love and family secrets — and at the center of it all is Lena, who has to decide who she's going to become.

Features

  • 10 characters with their own stories, voices and motives — from the leader of the courtyard crew to the best friend who knows every secret in the district

  • 5 different endings — from a fragile victory of friendship to a bitter truth that can't be undone

  • Hundreds of branching choices, where every decision — big or small — shapes who Lena becomes

  • 2000s atmosphere: a Nokia on a lanyard, courtyard slang, parties that run till morning and a Lada parked by the entrance — recreated down to the smallest detail

  • A distinctive visual style — anxious, warm and melancholic all at once

Who will you become?

Reputation in the yard doesn't come free. Every conversation, every party, every lie told for your own people is a step toward one of five endings. Will you stay true to yourself, or will a word given in the yard end up mattering more than anything else?

The Boy's Word isn't really about the boys. It's about the price everyone pays for wanting to belong.
